briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies AGI race amid escalating compute constraints

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race toward AGI with new model releases while regulatory scrutiny grows. Funding remains robust but infrastructure bottlenecks are emerging globally.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind and xAI push multimodal frontiers while DeepSeek releases open-weight challenger.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates as Microsoft and Google expand data center capacity. TSMC reports record AI chip orders amid global power grid strains.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level security like DialectForge become mandatory for all frontier model deployments by 2028?
